fusions.name: Anvil-Flat
fusions.desc: A two-handed blow that deals 40 damage, ignores armour and leaves the target 25% easier to wound for 8 seconds.

fusions.name: Ringing Floor
fusions.desc: Strikes the ground twice in one motion, dealing 14 damage to every enemy within 3 tiles and stunning each for 1.2 seconds.

fusions.name: Pounding Rig
fusions.desc: Sets down a trip-forge that lasts 12 seconds and pounds the nearest enemy within 3 tiles every 1.5 seconds for 6 damage.

fusions.name: Peened Over
fusions.desc: Each blow you land gives you a ward worth 15% of your maximum health for 5 seconds. Once every 8 seconds.
